⌨️ Setup commands (also saved as setup.sh)

Pick at least one thing from Frontend, Backend, or DevOps to build your ZIP.

🧩 Run it in VS Code
  1. Unzip the download, then code <project-folder>
  2. Open the integrated terminal — Ctrl/Cmd+`
  3. Run chmod +x setup.sh && ./setup.sh (or paste the commands above one by one)
  4. If a .vscode-workspace file was generated, double-click it to open every folder as one workspace
